feeds.title: Marcelle Guilbeau Blog
feeds.description: Marcelle Guilbeau is known for her soulful designs which reflect her client's unique styles and become havens for those who dwell within. She takes her clients on a journey-she reflects their sense of style & renews their connection to those things about which they're most passionate. Sharing tips, ideas, and philosophy through her blog.

feeds.title: Home By Hattan Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Karen Hattan, a Certified Expert Psychological Stager, and Interior Decorator. I design heart-happy, beautifully inviting, custom homes for today's diverse families, creating gorgeous spaces where clients can live comfortably and entertain friends in style! Read my tips on home staging and interior decorating in my Home By Hattan blog.

feeds.title: Nashville Interiors Magazine
feeds.description: At Nashville Interiors, they believe very simply that life is lived at home. Stunning visual experience for design, art, and architecture lovers. Nashville-based premier home building and design online and biannual print magazine. Read more about interior, outdoor, and living design.

feeds.title: Decorating Den Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Bohnne and Ciera are award-winning decorators providing complete interior design services to clients in and around Nashville. Our experienced decorators will give you a free in-home consultation and work that fit your style, taste, and budget. We listen, and beautiful happens. We share inspiration, designs, and ideas for renovating your homes.

feeds.title: Monarch Lane Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Monarch Lane Interiors! We are a full-service interior design firm. We help homeowners love the spaces they live in with a harmony of function and beauty. We accomplish this with our professional design education, signature process, and online design studio. We share our client experiences and design ideas on our blog.

feeds.title: Motiv Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Anna McGary is an interior designer who makes sustainability the priority in her firm. With over a decade of experience in hospitality, Anna ensures that MOTIV Interiors provides exceptional customer service while specializing in incorporating sustainable design principles into every project. She shares her views, designs, and ideas on her blog.

feeds.title: Thurman Design Studio Blog
feeds.description: Thurman Design Studio is a creative design firm, specializing in thoughtfully designed spaces that reflect personality. The purpose of my blog is to educate my readers by sharing the 'inside scoop' on the design world and, in turn, provide helpful insights that will inspire you to elevate and love the spaces you inhabit.

feeds.title: Beth Haley Design Blog
feeds.description: As an interior designer focused on highly functional yet comfortable spaces, we deliver clean, simple, and fresh architectural spaces. We have extensive experience in historic renovations and have a passion for kitchen and bath design. Beth Haley Design Blog provides tips and creative solutions to redecorating your home.

feeds.title: Jen Woodhouse Blog
feeds.description: Jen Woodhouse authors The House of Wood as her creative outlet for all things DIY and design, where she documents her adventures in woodworking, interior design, military life, marriage, and motherhood. She offers in-depth tutorials that inspire and encourage readers to build their way to a more beautiful home.

feeds.title: Nashville Office Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Nashville Office Interiors first opened in 1935 as Nashville Stationery, offering printing and office supplies to the surrounding Nashville community. We are hard-working, passionate, and determined to see things through. Follow the Nashville Office Interiors blog for ideas and inspiration for office planning, design, and furniture. It's time to create better office spaces!

feeds.title: Sara Ray Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Sara Ray's design aesthetic can best be described as 'old meets new.' I love classic, timeless design elements paired with clean lines. My two favorite things about being a designer are working with clients to discover their style and creating intentional, nourishing living spaces. Educating through her blog about gift guides, furniture selection, and more.

feeds.title: Design by Christina Perry Blog
feeds.description: Nashville-based interior design studio, design by Christina Perry, offers online à la carte interior design. Professional design services include full-service project management, concept development, and e-design. They are personalized to each client. The designer shares her perspective on designing various home styles.

feeds.title: A Beautiful Mess » Home Decor
feeds.description: We are a sister team Elsie Larson and Emma Chapman. Our motto is: Stay Home and Make Something. This pretty much describes the majority of the content on our site. we're a small team of creatives sharing ideas and inspiration with our readers every day about recipes, craft tutorials, and home decor.

feeds.title: The Decorologist
feeds.description: Kristie Barnett, The Decorologist, is a design, home staging, and color expert based in Nashville who educates both professionals and design enthusiasts. She focuses on helping homeowners create spaces that nourish the eye and nurture the soul. Learn about design trends on her blog.

feeds.title: T. Moore Home Blog
feeds.description: Blog by Interior Designer Teri Moore, featuring DIY home remodeling tutorials, affordable decor ideas, and easy projects.
